name: NY-16
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent George Latimer running for re-election
Republican challenger has reported no fundraising
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~98%
model.rationale: The district's D+18 lean, Latimer's incumbency, and a Republican opponent with no reported fundraising all point to a safe Democratic hold, and Polymarket prices a Democratic win at 98%. With no polls or expert ratings available, the fundamentals-based estimate of a 24-point margin stands.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected outside spending against Latimer would be the first sign the race is closer than fundamentals suggest.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
George Latimer, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking re-election in a Westchester-area district that leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan advantage of 18 points. He defeated a well-funded incumbent in 2024 and enters this race with the advantages of incumbency and name recognition. His Republican opponent, Joseph Cinquemani, has reported no fundraising activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, the incumbent's position, and prediction markets, which price a Democratic win at roughly 98 percent. The expected margin is about 24 points, consistent with a Safe Democratic rating, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty.
